claims.quote: The study demonstrated that multidose metronidazole (500 mg orally 2 times/day for 7 days) reduced the proportion of women retesting positive at a 1-month test of cure visit by half, compared with women who received the 2-g single dose.

claims.text: The 2 g single dose is the regimen for men
claims.quote: Recommended Regimen for Trichomoniasis Among Men Metronidazole 2 g orally in a single dose
